items.name: Tacos al Pastor
items.description: Marinated pork tacos with pineapple, onions, and cilantro on corn tortillas.

items.name: Chicken Enchiladas
items.description: Corn tortillas rolled around chicken filling and covered with chili sauce and cheese.

items.name: Guacamole
items.description: Fresh avocado dip with lime, cilantro, onions, and tomatoes. Served with tortilla chips.

items.name: Chiles Rellenos
items.description: Poblano peppers stuffed with cheese, battered and fried, served with tomato sauce.

items.name: Quesadillas
items.description: Grilled flour tortillas filled with cheese and your choice of chicken, beef, or vegetables.

items.name: Pozole
items.description: Traditional Mexican soup with hominy, pork, and red chiles, garnished with radish and lime.

items.name: Churros
items.description: Crispy fried dough pastries dusted with cinnamon sugar, served with chocolate sauce.

items.name: Horchata
items.description: Sweet rice milk drink flavored with cinnamon and vanilla.
